subject: Minimum commit & on‑prem support stack — pricing and concessions
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Luke Hammond <luke.h@clearharbor.com>, ClearHarbor Procurement <procurement@clearharbor.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Minimum commit & on‑prem support stack — pricing and concessions

Hi Luke / team,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. I promised to follow up with a clearer framing of the tradeoffs on the ClearHarbor private deployment (VPC + on‑prem agents) so you can take it to your procurement committee. High level: we can flex the committed GPU/node minimum down, but the platform fee and support retainer are the levers that preserve our economics.

Quick summary of options (see attached cost model for line‑by‑line):
- Option A (Standard): 6 committed A100-equivalent GPUs, platform fee amortized monthly, Standard SRE retainer (weekday coverage).
- Option B (Lower commit): 3 committed GPUs + higher per‑token overage rate, platform fee amortized over 12 months (one-time onboarding credit applied).
- Option C (Premier): 3 committed GPUs + Premier SRE (24/7 oncall) + multi‑region staging (adds a region fee).

Questions for procurement to confirm: target steady‑state GPU utilization (avg sustained GPUs used), appetite for higher overage price vs. committing capacity, and whether you require 24/7 or weekday response for initial 12 months.

Attachments: SOW-ClearHarbor-v2.pdf (SOW draft), cost-model-clearharbor.xlsx (line items we discussed).

If useful I can draft a conditional concession: reduce minimum commit to 3 GPUs, subject to a 12‑month committed term and a 15% amortization uplift on platform fee (or alternately a $150k onboarding credit split across first 6 invoices).

Next step from our side: looping in David (pricing) and Marissa (legal commercial) for a firm written concession. Luke — if you can confirm your preferred option and utilization target today, I’ll get a formal quote over.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Strategic Deals, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

From: Luke Hammond <luke.h@clearharbor.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearHarbor Procurement <procurement@clearharbor.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Minimum commit & on‑prem support stack — pricing and concessions

Hannah —

Appreciate the note. Our procurement team has two immediate asks: 1) can ClearHarbor get the minimum commit down to 3 GPUs for the first 9 months (we plan to ramp), and 2) we need a clearer breakdown of the platform fee vs. the systems retainer so we can model it as OPEX.

On utilization: we expect ~2.5 steady GPUs in Q4 ramping to ~4 by Q2. We do not want to sign a 24/7 retainer yet — weekday coverage is fine to start. Also, procurement will push back on any large upfront onboarding credit that effectively acts as a prepaid platform fee unless amortized.

If you can send a version with 3 GPU commit + explicit amortization schedule and a lower day‑time SRE retainer cost, we can circulate this internally.

—Luke
Luke Hammond
Head of Platform Engineering, ClearHarbor
luke.h@clearharbor.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Luke Hammond <luke.h@clearharbor.com>, ClearHarbor Procurement <procurement@clearharbor.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Minimum commit & on‑prem support stack — pricing and concessions

Thanks Luke — that usage profile helps. Looping in David (pricing) and Marissa (commercial/legal) to propose a formal concession.

Proposed concession (conditional):
- Minimum commit: 3 GPUs for first 9 months, then auto‑review at month 9.
- Platform fee: $240k annualized; for the concession we propose amortizing $80k of the platform fee over the first 12 months (line item in cost-model). The remaining platform fee will be billed normally.
- Support retainer: Standard SRE (weekday) at $40k/month. If you add Premier at any point, we’ll apply a credit equal to 25% of onboarding credit against the first 3 months of Premier.
- Exit language: cap exit fee to 3 months of net platform fee if termination is for convenience after year 1.

Tradeoffs we need: if you accept the 3 GPU commit, we need the 12‑month amortization on the $80k to keep our fiscal treatment intact. Alternatively, we can switch the amortization to a month‑by‑month credit on invoices (cleaner for procurement).

I’ll attach a redline of the license and a revised SOW for Markup — Marissa, any quick legal concerns before I send this back to Luke?

—Hannah

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Luke Hammond <luke.h@clearharbor.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Minimum commit & on‑prem support stack — pricing and concessions

Hannah / team — quick legal/commercial notes (high level):
- Redlines (attached redlines-license.docx): we can accept the capped exit fee and the 12‑month amortization approach, but want explicit language that amortization will be applied as an invoice credit (not prepaid cash), and that audit/log access requests follow SOC2 process windows.
- Support: clarify SLOs for Standard SRE (response time windows, severity definitions). If ClearHarbor wants to convert to Premier later, we need a 30‑day notice and an adjusted oncall provisioning SLA.
- Procurement ask on OPEX: confirm with finance that invoice credit amortization meets your capitalization policy — if not, we should present an alternate that is a month‑by‑month discount on invoice lines.

I’ll send a tracked redline and a one‑page summary for procurement to review.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Luke Hammond <luke.h@clearharbor.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Final concession & next steps (SOW + DocuSign)

Luke —

Thanks for confirming usage. Based on the internal review we can offer the following final concession:

1) Commit: 3 A100‑equivalent GPUs for an initial 9‑month committed term.
2) Platform fee treatment: $80k of the annual platform fee will be provided as an invoice credit distributed equally across 12 monthly invoices (line item: Platform Credit). This keeps accounting as an OPEX credit on your statements.
3) Support: Standard SRE retainer at $38k/month (reduced $2k as part of this concession) with weekday coverage. Premier is available later at a pro‑rated uplift.
4) Exit cap: capped to 3 months of net platform fee after month 12.

Attachments included: revised SOW (SOW-ClearHarbor-v2.pdf) and the excel cost model showing monthly amortization. I’ve also attached redlines for the license (redlines-license.docx). If this matches what you need, I’ll generate a DocuSign envelope and the HubSpot deal will be updated (CLH-2026-087).

Please confirm and we’ll send the DocuSign link today.

—David
David Kim
Director, Strategic Pricing, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com
